name: QIDI ASA-Aero @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 90 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 12 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 90 mm/s (8.1 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page: bed 80-110 C PEI, speed 30-90 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, nozzle >=0.4 mm (0.6 mm+ for thin walls), retraction OFF, raft gap 0.18-0.2 mm, max foaming ratio 250 %, keep enclosed printer in ventilated area, ambient 40-70 C during printing helps reduce warping (not a chamber setpoint). Nozzle 240-280 C and drying 70-80 C 6-8 h from comparison guide (closed chamber required, HDT 70 C). Density not published (foamed, temperature dependent). Store feed shipping weight 1300 g; assumed 1 kg net (unconfirmed). Annealing not recommended.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-tech-asa-areo-filament
